name: smwgraphics-bs-super-ninja-kun-sky-temple-interior
title: BS Super Ninja-Kun - Sky Temple (Interior)
description:
A temple-like that has three distinct statues, from the final level of Super Ninja-Kun, an exclusive Satellaview game. A great for final levels or eastern-themed temples, in general.

It uses an expanded horizontal level mode, because of how big the background is.

Credit would be great, but is optional.
